_readme: The Weibo accounts the watcher follows, uid -> screen name. Read by the weibo-watcher, scripts/weibo-relay.mjs, scripts/heat-backfill.mjs, /dev/heat and the admin playbook. The spare Weibo account must follow every account here. urgent accounts also need a rule in the watcher's ACCOUNTS (titles, media); update accounts a rule in UPDATE_ACCOUNTS. After a change: restart the relay, then deploy the watcher when adding (the reverse order when removing).
